subject: Post-call: security discovery — audit logs, SOC 2 & retention (LedgerCorp)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@ledgercorp.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@ledgercorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: security discovery — audit logs, SOC 2 & retention (LedgerCorp)

Hi Tom / Lina — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have a single place to track: 

Key pain points you raised
- Audit/log retention granularity: need per-tenant retention windows and exportable immutable logs for investigations.
- Regulatory posture: SOC 2 evidence + DPA terms (retention clauses) are required for finance and legal sign-off.
- Pen test: need results or summary of remediation for app-facing and infra issues.
- Data usage guarantees: explicit confirmation that customer data is not used to train public models.

Goals we heard
1) Validate Redwood can meet LedgerCorp retention and audit requirements by April POC.
2) Provide SOC 2 Type II report and redacted pen-test summary for procurement/legal review.
3) Define mutual action plan for an on-prem or VPC pilot if the Hosted offering needs additional controls.

What Redwood will provide (next 48h)
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and a high-level pen-test summary: will attach PDFs.
- Audit-log retention screenshot and notes on configurable retention (per-tenant params).
- Short note on encryption/KMS options (customer-managed keys supported).

Immediate asks for LedgerCorp
- Confirm the retention window required (e.g., 7 years vs 3 years) and whether immutable export is a must-have.
- Legal point of contact to receive DPA draft (if different from security@ledgercorp.com).

Proposed next steps
- I will upload the evidence bundle to the Drive link below and share access with your security and procurement teams.
- Can we lock a 30-min follow-up: Thu Mar 16, 10:00–10:30 PT or Fri Mar 17, 08:00–08:30 PT (technical deep-dive + procurement questions)?

Attachments (will follow in separate email/Drive): redwood-soc2-type2-2027.pdf, pen-test-summary-2027.pdf, auditlog-retention-screenshot.png
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/468291/LC-2028-317

Thanks — we want to make the evidence review as painless as possible.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@ledgercorp.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@ledgercorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 18:35:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery — audit logs, SOC 2 & retention (LedgerCorp)

Hey Priyom — thanks for the summary and for moving quickly. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Retention: our baseline is 7 years for transactional audit trails (finance), but we can discuss shorter windows for derivative logs. Immutable export is required for forensic purposes.
- Encryption: can you confirm whether customer keys are held in a tenant-specific KMS/HSM (we'd prefer a Bring-Your-Own-Key model).
- Data usage: we need an explicit statement that Redwood does not ingest customer prompts/outputs into any training corpus or shared telemetry used to update models.

Also, please loop in our procurement lead if you plan to send a DPA draft (procurement@ledgercorp.com).

Can you also confirm what portions of the pen-test report will be redacted? Our security team will want to see CVEs and remediation timelines, but we understand some vendor-sensitive artifacts may be redacted.

Tom
Tom Harris
Director of Security Engineering | LedgerCorp
tharris@ledgercorp.com | +1 (617) 555-4420

Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery — audit logs, SOC 2 & retention (LedgerCorp)

Tom / Lina — thanks for the quick follow-up. Per Priyom's note, attaching the evidence bundle and answering your specific questions below. Attachments (redacted as appropriate):
- redwood-soc2-type2-2027.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report, redacted PII sections)
- pen-test-summary-2027.pdf (executive summary and vulnerabilities/remediation timeline; full technical appendix available under NDA)
- auditlog-retention-screenshot.png (console view showing per-tenant retention settings)

Short answers to your bullets
- Retention: platform supports configurable retention windows per-tenant. We can set up a default 7-year retention for audit trails and a shorter retention for transient logs. Immutable export: yes — we support write-once export to AWS S3 with object lock for forensic preservation.
- KMS/HSM: BYOK supported via AWS KMS and external HSM integrations. Keys can be customer-managed and rotated on schedule; Redwood never persists plaintext keys.
- Data usage / training: Redwood does not use customer prompts or outputs for model training. We can include a contractual clause in the DPA that explicitly prohibits ingestion for training.
- Pen test redaction: the attached summary includes CVE identifiers and remediation dates. The full technical appendix (vulnerabilities by endpoint and PoC artifacts) will be shared under an NDA or during an on-site review.

Next actions / owners
- Redwood (Neha): Share Drive link with full evidence package and a one-page technical note on log export APIs (by EOD Thu).
- LedgerCorp (Tom): Confirm procurement contact and any mandatory contract language for retention/DPA (by Mon Mar 20).
- Redwood (Priyom): Schedule the 30-min technical deep-dive for Mar 16 or Mar 17 depending on availability.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D5E
HubSpot note: DEAL LC-2028-317 updated with evidence upload.

--
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-call: security discovery — audit logs, SOC 2 & retention (LedgerCorp)

Hi Neha / Priyom — thanks for the fast turnaround and the bundle. I reviewed the SOC 2 and pen-test summary briefly and they look solid. A couple of asks before we move to procurement: 
1) Can your team join a 30-min deep-dive on Thu Mar 16 at 10:00 PT (Priyom suggested) — focus on KMS configuration, log export API, and retention enforcement.
2) Procurement (procurement@ledgercorp.com) will take your DPA draft; please send to that mailbox and cc security@ledgercorp.com.
3) For the mutual action plan, can you propose a simple 6-week pilot checklist (evidence review, sandbox access, retention config, smoke tests, final sign-off)? We prefer a short MOP that procurement can attach to the SOW.

If you can send the DPA and the 6-week MOP by EOD today, we can target a procurement review next week. 

Thanks — Lina
Lina Gomez
VP Engineering | LedgerCorp
